record.question: In the union government the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the:
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
For the Union government, Article 75(3) makes the Council of Ministers collectively responsible to the “House of the People,” the Constitution’s name for Lok Sabha. Parliament includes both Houses, but this clause names only the lower House. Article 164(2), by contrast, makes a State Council of Ministers collectively responsible to that State’s Legislative Assembly.

Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/cb1b190ea633a1746368ed1fac35fb30.pdf
